724:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

724:t_1:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「...In the end, that $$サクリファイ$$ was the same as the other $$御使い$$s...」

724:t_1:5.en:
$$シリウス$$
「And they turned out to be what the Earthlings of a parallel world ultimately became.」

724:t_1:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「So that's why events in space were measured in Earth calendar units... It was because of those guys' influence...」

724:t_1:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What truth!? Where do those guys accept others and walk together with them!?」

724:t_1:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「But it's because they reached the truth that the path of $$シンカ$$ opened up and they became higher-dimensional life forms.」

724:t_1:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Most likely, the coexistence they achieved was one of the spirit... a fusion of lives, so to speak.」

724:t_1:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$サクリファイ$$ said that all Earthlings had ascended into four $$御使い$$s...」

724:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I believe that means the lives of all humans became one, and then split into four, one for each basic human emotion: joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure.」

724:t_1:13.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「So those guys are beings formed by the fusion of countless lives...」

724:t_1:14.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$ tried to accomplish that by borrowing the power of the System.」

724:t_1:15.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「It was the same with the people of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

724:t_1:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We should assume such attempts were made in many forms, in many different worlds.」

724:t_1:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(What that $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$ was trying to do was one of them, too...)

724:t_1:18.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Like the $$バジュラ$$ and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, there are life forms in the universe that have existed as a collective like that from the very beginning.」

724:t_1:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$御使い$$s... in other words, the Earthlings of this universe, too, chose that form as their coexistence and were reborn as higher-dimensional life forms, I take it.」

724:t_1:20.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Still, the people of Earth in this world must have been nothing but arrogant types.」

724:t_1:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah. The $$御使い$$s, every last one of them, completely look down on the rest of humanity.」

724:t_1:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...In a sense, that's hardly surprising.」

724:t_1:23.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're giving the $$御使い$$s a pass...!?」

724:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I don't know what kind of people the Earthlings were before they became $$御使い$$s. But the fact is, the $$御使い$$s are transcendent beings.」

724:t_1:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To them, a humanity still on the road of evolution is insignificant... One could even say it's inevitable that arrogance is born from that.」

724:t_1:26.en:
$$シリウス$$
「$$ゼロ$$... Do those words come from your own experience, as one with the power of $$ギアス$$ and a genius for strategy?」

724:t_1:27.en:
$$カレン$$
「What do you mean by that, $$シリウス$$!」

724:t_1:28.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I don't mean it as a jab or sarcasm. It's a question out of pure curiosity.」

724:t_1:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's all right, $$カレン$$. Speaking frankly is important.」

724:t_1:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Besides, $$シリウス$$... isn't that question really about yourself, born to a royal family and possessing the power of the $$エレメント$$?」

724:t_1:31.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Heh... You see right through me.」

724:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let me state my view.」

724:t_1:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「When a teacher looks at a student... no, when a parent looks at a small child, they naturally feel the child is immature, and at times act like a god.」

724:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And at times, from the child's side, that becomes unforgivable arrogance, and an object of dread.」

724:t_1:35.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So because the $$御使い$$s are the same, you're saying they can't be helped...!?」

724:t_1:36.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Being a parent doesn't give anyone the right to take away a child's fate.」

724:t_1:38.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I agree with $$ゼロ$$'s view. No matter what power one holds, no one has the right to do as they please with another's life.」

724:t_1:39.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Let alone when it's goodwill forced upon others. That cannot be allowed.」

724:t_1:40.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Life doesn't have to obey anyone... That's all there is to it.」

724:t_1:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's true that the $$御使い$$s unified the will of all Earthlings and were reborn as higher-dimensional life forms. That could be called a kind of coexistence.」

724:t_1:42.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But truth is not something that should stay confined to a single star or a single race.」

724:t_1:43.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's right. It must be something life needs in order to spread through this vast, boundless universe.」

724:t_1:44.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If they're going to get friendly anyway, they should do it with the whole universe, not just their own kin.」

724:t_1:45.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$御使い$$s who can't grasp that can, conversely, be called those who obstruct the truth of the universe.」

724:t_1:46.en:
$$カレン$$
「So we have no choice but to fight...」

724:t_1:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I hear that, thanks to Dr. $$トライア$$ and the others' survey, the positions of the Solar System and Earth in this $$カオス・コスモス$$ have been identified as well.」

724:t_1:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At the same time, I hear they learned something about this universe's peculiarity.」

724:t_1:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I hear this universe is connected to every parallel world.」

724:t_1:52.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Then it's the same sort of thing as the $$天柱$$ that pierces the Milky Way Galaxy of every parallel world.」

724:t_1:53.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「As expected of a universe inhabited by those who call themselves administrators. They must have remade their own universe in order to interfere with other worlds.」

724:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At the same time, I hear it was confirmed that in each of the parallel worlds, the distortion of the universe is progressing at an accelerating pace.」

724:t_1:56.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I knew it... The great collapse of the universe never ended...!?」

724:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That would seem to be the case.」

724:t_1:58.en:
$$カレン$$
「I thought we'd sent the nest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ off into the gap between dimensions, but some of it is still out there somewhere...」

724:t_1:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$御使い$$s probably know the truth behind it.」

724:t_1:60.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then all we have to do is barge in on them and get it out in the open.」

724:t_1:61.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$エス・テラン$$... the star of God... So everything gets decided there...」

724:t_2:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm sorry... I'm so sorry, 《$$浜本$$》... There was nothing I could do...」

724:t_2:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Dad... I... I might end up ruining the company...」

724:t_2:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Father... Why did you die and leave me behind...」

724:t_2:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$バーコフ$$, $$ゴダン$$, $$コチャック$$, $$ザキ$$... They all... died...」

724:t_2:7.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm sorry, $$ティナ$$... And $$ミムジィ$$... Will I... never see you again...」

724:t_2:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stay back, $$ジェリド$$...! I'm... not a killer...!」

724:t_2:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How many more times do I have to kill that girl and that puppy...」

724:t_2:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「We are the enemy of the world... $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...」

724:t_2:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't go, $$ティファ$$...! Don't... leave me behind!」

724:t_2:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Lady $$ディアナ$$... We must be parting for good now... mustn't we...」

724:t_2:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$...! You... are of the $$ザビ家$$...」

724:t_2:18.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Papa... 《$$スミス$$》...! $$キミコ$$... $$ユング#pilot$$, everyone...!」

724:t_2:19.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$! I'm... not your Big Sis!」

724:t_2:20.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Why...! Why won't you listen to my song!」

724:t_2:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm sorry... I... can't answer your feelings...」
